connector.name: Markdown Vault MCP
connector.registryDescription: Markdown vault MCP server with FTS5 + semantic search and frontmatter indexing
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package markdown-vault-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pvliesdonk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.description: Log level for FastMCP internals; app loggers default to INFO, -v overrides both to DEBUG

env.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
env.description: Unified key-value backend for HTTP session persistence (file:///path or memory://). Legacy alias: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EVENT_STORE_URL
